Variants.Content: Nautical charts record coastal outlines, ports, islands, reefs, and approximate voyages. The accuracy depends on the experience of the mapper and the quality of the copy. The captain often adds water depth, wind season and dangerous anchorage to the map; if an old map is not revised according to changes in coast and port conditions, it may also lead to the ship's death.
